Container.Name: house-planner
Container.Overview:
House Planner is a self-hosted, browser-based planner for a house and its plot: floor plans in 2D, a 3D view with openings, the site on a map, and a materials list with prices and purchase tracking. The plan is stored on the server as JSON with numbered versions and named snapshots, behind a single password.
On first start, either set HOUSE_PASSWORD (8+ characters) or leave it empty and open http://[IP]:[PORT]/api/setup.php to set a password in the setup wizard. HOUSE_PASSWORD is only applied to empty storage; to change it later, delete config.php from the appdata folder and restart.
This image is built automatically from the unmodified upstream source (github.com/egmalt/house-planner) and rebuilt whenever upstream changes.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: house home floor plan floorplan architecture 3d construction
Container.Requires: For HTTPS or access outside your LAN, put it behind a reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, etc.).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the web UI.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Plan, version history, snapshots and config.php.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional. At least 8 characters. Sets the login password on first start so the setup wizard is skipped. Ignored once storage is initialised.

Config.Name: Setup Key
Config.Description: Optional. If set, the /api/setup.php wizard requires this extra key.

Config.Name: Demo Mode
Config.Description: Set to 1 for a public demo: no password, and the plan resets every hour. Leave empty for normal use.
